document.about: Panasonic FP series PLC digest catalogue (28 pages): feature lists numbered in the item's own text, dimension drawings with hole callouts, and a date and web address on the cover and the back page. Page 20's product table gives each control unit's number of I/O points (`10`, `14`, `16`, `32`), a figure alone in its cell.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.
2026-11-24 (#129): a number hyphenated into the word after it was read as a section number.

2026-11-24 (#99): every one- and two-digit cell was taken for a page number and emptied, so the I/O points column had no value in any row. The checks read the text projection, since the table's first row is still taken for its header (`Number 10`), a separate fault.

checks.issue: The drawing's `4-M4` hole callout was a level-1 section, and the rest of the page nested under it.
The web address on the cover and the back page was a level-6 heading.
As above, after the cover's date.
The I/O points `14` was emptied as a page number.
